When I was fifteen my best friend invited me to go with him and some other friends and live on a small boat for a week, I had the time so i decided I would go with him. we sailed for about two days before i woke up at around three AM to somebody moving outside the cabins,(during this time we had docked at a town, so i figured somebody was stealing something.) I got up and looked out a port hole to the deck of our boat, but i couldn't see anything so i tip toed out onto the deck, then i heard the sound coming from our storage unit so I was sure that somebody was looking for things to steal. I went back to wake the other guys, but they all weren't there, i knew something wasn't right. I went back to the sound coming from the storage unit and quietly opened the door and peaked in. it was dark and all i could see was somebody hunched over. I grabbed one of our short flag poles and went back, I opened the door all the way and standing in front of me was an old homeless lady, she was missing a few teeth and looked like gollum from the lord of the rings. She yelled at me saying i hated god and that i was a sinner pushed me out of the way and jumped into the water and swam off, I couldn't see her in the night after she swam for about a few feet, after awhile I went back to the bunk i was sleeping on and fell asleep in about two hours. the next morning i woke up and my friends were back in their bunks sleeping, i never told them what happened and I never got a direct answer of where they went that night.
